policy.scope: Keep exactly the user's 18 references; transcribe visible, legible page text including graphics and logos.
policy.provenance: The user states all 18 were checked. CONFIRMED in the revised transport file records Codex's image QA and amendments, not a fabricated human signature on those amendments.
policy.reading_order: Title; main blocks left to right, each block top to bottom; footer last. Tables: header then complete rows. Graphics with no natural reading order use the explicit token sequence in this patch and are marked layout_sensitive.
policy.math: ASCII underscore for subscripts; parentheses group compound subscripts; Unicode superscript ² for squares; retain visible angle brackets and ±. This is a transcription convention, not math recognition accuracy.
policy.legibility: Do not reconstruct obscured or cropped characters. Include only complete legible ruler numerals; excluded fragments are recorded outside the reference text.
policy.metrics: NFC plus whitespace collapse; preserve case, digits and punctuation. Full-page sequence CER/WER includes layout and serialization effects. No automatic DPI or threshold decision.

transport_schema_note: m23_human_review is the existing interchange format; reference amendment provenance is explicitly AI, not a new human review.
